users_store_staff_have_a_store.name: users_store_staff_have_a_store
users_store_staff_have_a_store.value: role <> 'store' OR store_id IS NOT NULL

stores_pin_in_indonesia.name: stores_pin_in_indonesia
stores_pin_in_indonesia.value: (lat IS NULL OR lat BETWEEN -11.5 AND 6.5) AND (lng IS NULL OR lng BETWEEN 94.5 AND 141.5)

stores_active_has_address_and_pin.name: stores_active_has_address_and_pin
stores_active_has_address_and_pin.value: active IS NOT TRUE OR (lat IS NOT NULL AND lng IS NOT NULL AND address IS NOT NULL AND btrim(address) <> '')

stock_levels_quantity_non_negative.name: stock_levels_quantity_non_negative
stock_levels_quantity_non_negative.value: quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity >= 0 AND quantity = trunc(quantity)

orders_lines_priced.name: orders_lines_priced
orders_lines_priced.value: qty IS NOT NULL AND qty >= 1 AND qty = trunc(qty) AND unit_price IS NOT NULL AND unit_price >= 0 AND unit_price = trunc(unit_price) AND line_total IS NOT NULL AND line_total = unit_price * qty

orders_totals_priced.name: orders_totals_priced
orders_totals_priced.value: totals_subtotal IS NOT NULL AND totals_subtotal >= 0 AND totals_discount IS NOT NULL AND totals_discount >= 0 AND totals_delivery_fee IS NOT NULL AND totals_delivery_fee >= 0 AND totals_total IS NOT NULL AND totals_total >= 0 AND totals_discount <= totals_subtotal AND totals_total = totals_subtotal - totals_discount + totals_delivery_fee

orders_totals_whole.name: orders_totals_whole
orders_totals_whole.value: totals_subtotal = trunc(totals_subtotal) AND totals_discount = trunc(totals_discount) AND totals_delivery_fee = trunc(totals_delivery_fee) AND totals_total = trunc(totals_total)

payment_events_gross_amount_whole.name: payment_events_gross_amount_whole
payment_events_gross_amount_whole.value: gross_amount IS NULL OR (gross_amount >= 0 AND gross_amount = trunc(gross_amount))

discounts_value_valid.name: discounts_value_valid
discounts_value_valid.value: value IS NOT NULL AND value >= 1 AND value = trunc(value) AND (kind <> 'percent' OR value <= 100)

discounts_min_spend_whole.name: discounts_min_spend_whole
discounts_min_spend_whole.value: min_spend IS NULL OR (min_spend >= 0 AND min_spend = trunc(min_spend))

discounts_usage_counted.name: discounts_usage_counted
discounts_usage_counted.value: used_count IS NOT NULL AND used_count >= 0 AND used_count = trunc(used_count) AND (usage_limit IS NULL OR (usage_limit >= 1 AND usage_limit = trunc(usage_limit) AND used_count <= usage_limit))

discounts_window_ordered.name: discounts_window_ordered
discounts_window_ordered.value: starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

products_variants_price_whole_rupiah.name: products_variants_price_whole_rupiah
products_variants_price_whole_rupiah.value: price IS NULL OR (price >= 1 AND price = trunc(price))

products_price_whole_rupiah.name: products_price_whole_rupiah
products_price_whole_rupiah.value: price IS NULL OR (price >= 1 AND price = trunc(price))
